get.summary: Retrieve transactions for a platform account

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Name of the platform. Currently, only "onlyfans" is supported.

parameters.name: platform_account_id
parameters.description: Unique account identifier returned by the OnlyFans platform.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start of the transaction creation timestamp range (ISO 8601 Zulu).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End of the transaction creation timestamp range (ISO 8601 Zulu).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (min:10 max:1000 default:100)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor returned from the previous request.

200.description: List of transactions successfully retrieved for the specified platform account.

items.description: Array of transaction records associated with the account.

id.description: Globally unique identifier of the transaction.

fan.description: Information about the fan involved in the transaction.

type.description: Categorization of the transaction (e.g., tip, message payment, recurring subscription, post purchase, live stream, unknown).

status.description: Current state of the transaction (done, loading, pending return).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the transaction occurred.

cursor.description: Base64-encoded cursor used for paginating subsequent results. Included only if additional pages exist.

get.summary: Retrieve chargebacks for a platform account

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Name of the platform. Currently, only "onlyfans" is supported.

parameters.name: platform_account_id
parameters.description: Unique account identifier returned by the OnlyFans platform.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start of the chargeback creation timestamp range (ISO 8601 Zulu).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End of the chargeback creation timestamp range (ISO 8601 Zulu).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (min:10 max:1000 default:100)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor returned from the previous request.

200.description: List of chargebacks successfully retrieved for the specified platform account.

items.description: Array of chargeback records associated with the account.

id.description: Globally unique identifier of the chargeback transaction.

fan.description: Information about the fan associated with this chargeback.

type.description: Type of the original transaction (e.g., tip, message payment).

status.description: Current state of the chargeback (e.g., undo).

chargeback_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the chargeback was created.

transaction_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the original transaction.

cursor.description: Base64-encoded cursor used for paginating subsequent results. Present only if additional pages exist.

get.summary: Retrieve trial links for a platform account

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Name of the platform. Currently, only "onlyfans" is supported.

parameters.name: platform_account_id
parameters.description: Unique account identifier returned by the OnlyFans platform.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start of the trial link creation timestamp range (ISO 8601 Zulu).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End of the trial link creation timestamp range (ISO 8601 Zulu).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (min:10 max:1000 default:100)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor returned from the previous request.

200.description: List of trial links successfully retrieved for the specified platform account.

items.description: Array of trial link records associated with the account.

id.description: Unique identifier of the trial link.

name.description: Name of the trial link. May be empty if not set.

claims.description: Number of times the trial link has been claimed.

claims_limit.description: Maximum number of claims allowed for the trial link.

url.description: Full URL of the trial link.

duration_days.description: Duration in days of free access granted by the trial link.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the trial link expires, or null if still active.

is_active.description: Indicates whether the trial link is currently active.

clicks.description: Total number of clicks registered for this trial link.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the trial link was created.

cursor.description: Base64-encoded cursor used for paginating subsequent results. Present only if additional pages exist.

parameters.description: End of the metrics timestamp range (ISO 8601 Zulu).
